_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Niwe mchezaji {player_id} mu mupila wa LinesOfAction.
Mbila zako ni '{side}', mbila za mwenzi ni '{other}'.
Mfumo wa kusogola: `[b1b3]` (kutoka-mpangilio hadi-mpangilio). Sogolo la kisheria husafiri wima, mlalo, au diagonal nambari ya miraba sawa na jumla ya mbila (rang'i yoyote) kwenye mstari ule. Ungaweza kukuruka juu ya mbila zako, lakini si mbila za mwenzi; kutua kwa mwenzi kumkamata.  Ushinde wakati mbila zako zote zimeunganishwa kwa ukaribu wa 8.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifyakupilibula fifwile ukuba e2e4 (ukufuma, ukuya ku mikobelo).
invalid_move.identical: Uko bafuma ne ko bafumako fyaba fimo fine.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ukwenda kwalingile ukuba ukwa kulungama nelyo ukwalingana.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Mufwile ukulamoneka kwati muli pa mulongo.
invalid_move.destination_own: Uko baleya ni ku cipondo cabo.
